Prepare a cover identity for yourself and up to three companions. Each gains 2 Boons to Guile or Reason rolls to maintain it.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes of preparation.
Target / range / shape
One mundane disguise and plausible role.
Equipment / acquisition
Suitable clothing.
Type
Skill / Utility

Prepare a plausible role with suitable clothing. Learn one observable detail or habit that helps sell it. While maintaining that disguise, gain 1 Boon to Guile rolls passing as the role.
